history.avgPopularity: Mean of Spotify's own 0-100 popularity score across your deduplicated top tracks (short/medium/long-term windows combined).
history.deepCuts: percent = (top tracks with popularity < 40 ÷ total deduplicated top tracks) × 100.
history.tasteDiversity: Shannon entropy of your genre distribution, normalized 0-1 by the max possible entropy for that many distinct genres: score = −Σ p·log₂(p) ÷ log₂(N), where p is each genre's share of tagged artists and N is the number of distinct genres.
history.eraVsPopularity: Pearson correlation (r) between each top track's release year and its popularity score: r = Σ(dx·dy) ÷ √(Σdx² · Σdy²), where dx/dy are each point's distance from the mean year/popularity.
history.popularityDistribution: Track count per 10-point bucket of Spotify's 0-100 popularity score, across your deduplicated top tracks.
history.tasteByDecade: Track count grouped by the release decade of each top track's album (release year, rounded down to the nearest 10).
history.genreBreakdown: Count of distinct artists (deduplicated by Spotify id) tagged with each genre, across your top-artist lists — one count per artist per genre, not weighted by plays.
history.cohorts: Classified by presence across Spotify's short-term (~4 weeks), medium-term (~6 months), and long-term (years) top-item windows: Core = in all three, New Discoveries = only in the short-term window, Fading Out = in medium/long-term but has dropped out of short-term.
history.genrePairings: Count of top artists tagged with both genres at once, across your deduplicated short/medium/long-term top-artist lists — a simple co-occurrence count, not a normalized association measure.

insights.peakHour: The hour-of-day (0-23, your local time) with the highest total minutes summed across your selected range.
insights.peakDay: The day-of-week (your local time) with the highest total minutes summed across your selected range.
insights.byHour: Total minutes played, summed by hour-of-day (your local time) across your selected range — a play at 9:15pm on any date adds to the 9pm bucket.
insights.byWeekday: Total minutes played, summed by day-of-week (your local time) across your selected range.
insights.heatmap: Each cell sums total minutes played in that hour/weekday slot. Opacity = 0.2 + 0.8 × (cell minutes ÷ busiest cell's minutes), so the busiest slot is fully opaque and empty slots fall back to the divider color.
insights.dayPartBreakdown: percent = (minutes played in that part of day ÷ total minutes) × 100, where each hour-of-day bucket is assigned to Night (12a–6a), Morning (6a–12p), Afternoon (12p–6p), or Evening (6p–12a).

analysis.longestStreak: Longest run of consecutive calendar days (your local time) with at least one play, across your full history.
analysis.currentStreak: Run of consecutive calendar days with a play, ending on the most recent day present in your data (not necessarily today).
analysis.totalSessions: A new session starts whenever the gap since the previous play ended exceeds 30 minutes; consecutive plays within that gap merge into one session.
analysis.avgSession: Mean session duration and track count across every session in the selected range (session = a run of plays with no gap over 30 minutes).
analysis.skipRate: percent = (plays where Spotify's own export marks skipped: true ÷ total plays) × 100.
analysis.distinctArtists: Count of distinct artist names across all plays in the selected range.
analysis.sessionsPer: Sessions are built by sorting all plays chronologically and starting a new one whenever the gap since the previous play ended exceeds 30 minutes; each bar counts sessions whose start falls in that period.
analysis.skipRateOverTime: percent = (plays marked skipped ÷ total plays) × 100, computed separately within each period.
analysis.diversityOverTime: Normalized Shannon entropy of each period's artist play-share, scaled 0-100: score = 100 × (−Σ p·log₂(p) ÷ log₂(N)), where p is an artist's share of that period's plays and N is the number of distinct artists played that period.
analysis.newArtistsPer: Each artist's first-ever play (found across your FULL history, not just the selected range) is bucketed by period; a period's bar is the count of artists whose first play falls there.
analysis.listeningTrend: Least-squares linear regression of total minutes per period against the period index: slope = Σ(dx·dy) ÷ Σ(dx²). R² (= Pearson r²) measures fit quality, 0-1. Direction is 'flat' when |slope| is under 2% of the average minutes per period — otherwise up/down.
analysis.weekdayVsWeekend: Welch's t-test on daily total minutes, weekday vs weekend: t = (mean₁ − mean₂) ÷ √(var₁/n₁ + var₂/n₂). The two-tailed p-value comes from the normal approximation to the t-distribution (accurate here since there are usually dozens to hundreds of days per group); significant if p < 0.05.
analysis.correlationHighlights: Pearson correlation r = Σ(dx·dy) ÷ √(Σdx² · Σdy²), computed pairwise across four per-period series (Minutes, Skip Rate, Diversity, New Artists), each built from the same aligned, equal-length list of periods.
analysis.spikeDays: z-score = (day's total minutes − mean daily minutes) ÷ standard deviation, across every active day in your history. The top 3 days with z > 2 are shown.
analysis.quietDays: Same z-score as Spike Days (day's minutes − mean ÷ standard deviation), showing the 3 lowest days with z < −2.
